# CardioSmart

> > CardioSmart is the American College of Cardiology's patient education platform providing evidence-based information on heart conditions, cardiac health, and cardiovascular disease management.

CardioSmart, powered by the American College of Cardiology (ACC), is a comprehensive patient engagement resource offering educational guides on cardiac conditions, preventive care, and heart health management. The platform emphasizes shared decision-making and provides tools to help patients find quality cardiac care.

## Key Topics

- American College of Cardiology
- Patient Education
- Cardiac Health
- Heart Disease
- Coronary Artery Disease
- Heart Valve Disease
- Atherosclerosis
- Cardiac Rehabilitation
- Shared Decision-Making
- Implantable Cardioverter Defibrillators (ICDs)
- LDL Cholesterol
- Statins
- Wearable Technology
- Cardio-Oncology
- COVID-19 and Heart Health

## Getting Started

- [Home](https://www.cardiosmart.org/home): CardioSmart homepage with patient education on heart conditions and cardiac health
- [About CardioSmart](https://www.cardiosmart.org/about): About CardioSmart patient engagement program by American College of Cardiology
- [Find Your Heart a Home](https://www.cardiosmart.org/findyourheartahome): Find Your Heart a Home tool for hospital search and cardiac care comparison

## Heart Conditions & Diseases

- [Coronary Artery Disease](https://www.cardiosmart.org/topics/coronary-artery-disease): Coronary artery disease overview with risk factors and treatment information
- [Atherosclerosis](https://www.cardiosmart.org/topics/atherosclerosis): Atherosclerosis overview covering plaque buildup and preventive care
- [Angina (Chest Pain)](https://www.cardiosmart.org/topics/angina): Patient education guide on angina, chest pain types, and treatment options
- [Aortic Stenosis](https://www.cardiosmart.org/topics/aortic-stenosis): Guide to aortic stenosis heart valve disease symptoms and treatment
- [Aortic Aneurysm](https://www.cardiosmart.org/topics/aortic-aneurysm): Educational overview of aortic aneurysm types, symptoms, and treatments
- [Bradycardia](https://www.cardiosmart.org/topics/bradycardia): Patient education on bradycardia, slow heart rate, and symptom management
- [Congenital Heart Disease](https://www.cardiosmart.org/topics/congenital-heart-disease): Educational guide on congenital heart disease and birth defect conditions
- [Endocarditis](https://www.cardiosmart.org/topics/endocarditis): Educational resource on endocarditis heart infection and valve disease
- [Cardiac Amyloidosis](https://www.cardiosmart.org/topics/cardiac-amyloidosis): Patient resource on cardiac amyloidosis types, symptoms, and treatment

## Specialized Topics

- [Familial Hypercholesterolemia](https://www.cardiosmart.org/topics/familial-hypercholesterolemia): Guide to familial hypercholesterolemia genetic condition and cholesterol management
- [Cancer Treatment and Your Heart](https://www.cardiosmart.org/topics/cancer-treatment-and-your-heart): Cardio-oncology guide on cancer treatment cardiac side effects and prevention
- [COVID-19 and Your Heart](https://www.cardiosmart.org/topics/coronavirus): COVID-19 heart health guide covering vaccines, myocarditis, and long COVID
- [Cardiac Rehabilitation](https://www.cardiosmart.org/topics/cardiac-rehabilitation): Cardiac rehabilitation guide covering supervised exercise and heart recovery
